question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

As the company's client base grew at an unexpected rate, management was forced to ________ some work until they could hire new staff.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **"farm out**". (किराये पर देना)
 
• The phrase "**farm out**" means to contract work out to others.
 
 
• **Example**: *We will need to farm out the data entry tasks to another team.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the use of **"farm out"** suggests that management had to outsource some work until they could hire new staff.
 
• Hence, **"farm out" **is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

**Complete Sentence**: "As the company's client base grew at an unexpected rate, management was forced to **farm out__** some work until they could hire new staff."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rat out**: It means to betray or inform someone, usually by revealing their wrongdoing. (चुगली करना)
 
• **Man up**: It means to act bravely, or responsibly, especially in challenging situations. (साहस दिखाना)
 
• **Dish out**: It means to distribute or allocate something, usually in a generous or sometimes haphazard manner. (बांटना)
